systems.label: Human T1/T2 support (estimate)
systems.notes: ESTIMATE, not measured. Cost and time are judgement figures built from IT-helpdesk benchmarks (MetricNet via HDI, 2016, not inflation-adjusted) and are not specific to game hosting. Time to resolution: p50 = 24 h and p95 = 5 days (432,000,000 ms). These are our judgement, based on a typical first response of about 24 h and resolution in days; no game host publishes a response-time SLA, and the only evidence is anecdotal (customer reviews and a competitor's blog post). Cost per ticket: 70% of tickets are resolved at T1 ($15.56 per ticket) and 30% are escalated to T2 and add $109.15 for desktop support. Blended = 0.70 x 15.56 + 0.30 x (15.56 + 109.15) = $10.89 + $37.41 = $48.31 per ticket, so cost_per_1k_usd = 1000 x 48.305 = 48,305. The 70/30 escalation share is our assumption. Success rate, turns, tokens and unintended-change rate are null because no measurement exists; the estimate assumes the ticket is eventually resolved.
